title: We March as One
description:
We March as One is an incremental-style auto battler about building a massive army of shapes with mutliple ways to play:

• Campaign - Build your army battle by battle

• Tactics - Fixed army puzzles where placement and orders are everything

• Command - Real-time orders and battlefield abilities

• Muster - Fixed budget puzzles where you choose the army

• Sandbox - Build custom levels and armies

Paint Your Army

• Paint your troops directly onto the battlefield however you like

• Tactically position them to counter the enemy force

Command Your Troops

• Order your troops before the battle starts to plan out your tactics

• Issue a MARCH command to set up a flank on the enemy or a HOLD command to play more defensively

Upgrade Your Units

• Earn gold from defeated enemies, whether you win or lose the battle

• Recruit more troops, unlock new unit types from a branching skill tree, and return with a stronger army

• Fallen troops return for the next battle, so you keep the army you’ve built

Massive Battles
• Every soldier and projectile is individually simulated

• 2D, 3D, or fly-through modes give you multiple ways to view the action

Sandbox Mode

• Full level editor where you can build and save custom maps

• Experiment with large unit counts and unusual army compositions across different battlefield layouts

• Unlock troops and upgrades in the sandbox by encountering them in the other game modes
description_short: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.
